description: This file implements the QuicPathValidator class and related components for managing QUIC path validation, including handling path validation requests, responses, retries, and associated alarms.

classes.name: RetryAlarmDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for handling retry alarms in path validation, invoking OnRetryTimeout on the associated QuicPathValidator.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the path validation context's addresses to an ostream.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::QuicPathValidator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the path validator with necessary components.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::OnPathResponse
methods.description: Handles incoming path response frames and validates them against ongoing path validation.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::StartPathValidation
methods.description: Begins a new path validation process with provided context and delegate.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::ResetPathValidation
methods.description: Resets the current path validation state.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::CancelPathValidation
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing path validation and notifies delegate of failure.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::HasPendingPathValidation
methods.description: Checks if a path validation is currently pending.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::GetContext
methods.description: Returns the current path validation context.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::ReleaseContext
methods.description: Releases ownership of the current path validation context.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::GeneratePathChallengePayload
methods.description: Generates a new path challenge payload with random bytes.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::OnRetryTimeout
methods.description: Handles retry timeout, possibly resending path challenge or cancelling after max retries.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::SendPathChallengeAndSetAlarm
methods.description: Sends a path challenge and sets the retry alarm.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::IsValidatingPeerAddress
methods.description: Checks if the given address matches the current validation's peer address.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::MaybeWritePacketToAddress
methods.description: Sends a packet to the peer address if validation is pending for that address.
